lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 16 -- What Happened Before?

listenings.text: Hello, and thank you for sending your profile. Here is a short summary for the program. You were a school director for twenty-five years, and your first school was a small public school in the east of São Paulo. There were four hundred students and only twelve teachers. In 2023 you were at the INSTI conference, and that was your first international event. Last year you were part of the Meteoro Program. If something here is not correct, please write to me before Friday. Thank you.

Hi, this is a short message about last week. The meeting was on Tuesday, not on Monday, and it was only thirty minutes. Two people were not there, because they were at the conference in Recife. The report was ready, but the data about small schools was not complete. It was not a problem: we were all in agreement about the next step. The next meeting is in two weeks. Thank you very much.

extra_audio.text: Joice reads the profile of the event program on her computer. She sees that the text about her first school is correct. She remembers the twelve teachers of that school. She writes one small correction about the year. She sends the profile back before Friday.

lesson.grammar_point: simple past of to be (was / were)

paras: Joice Lopes Leite is a consultant in educational technology in São Paulo, Brazil. Before this, she was a school director for twenty-five years.
Her first school was a small public school in the east of the city. There were four hundred students and only twelve teachers. It was difficult, and it was also the best school of her career.
In 2023 she was at the INSTI conference in the United States. It was her first international event, and the sessions were in English.
Last year she was part of the Meteoro Program with universities from Canada, Germany and the United States. This year she is a speaker for the first time.
